proof_object: A same-theory normalization lemma preserving reflection positivity for independently defined Wilson observables under a collar compatibility hypothesis.
target_commitment: Reflection positivity of the target Wilson observable algebra, stated before the normalization map is introduced.
proposed_move: Prove the collar compatibility hypothesis and then reuse the transfer certificate in the finite Wilson block theorem.

conceptual_depth.evidence: The theorem attacks the same-theory normalization gate rather than endpoint bookkeeping.
conceptual_depth.missing_evidence: Full proof-quality review remains required before manuscript promotion.
conceptual_depth.demotion_trigger: Demote if the target positivity predicate is later defined through the normalization map.

explanatory_power.evidence: The collar compatibility hypothesis explains why normalization can preserve positivity.
explanatory_power.missing_evidence: Needs proof of the collar compatibility estimate.
explanatory_power.demotion_trigger: Demote if the hypothesis is unused.

unification_power.evidence: Connects finite Wilson observables and normalized target observables without identifying them definitionally.
unification_power.missing_evidence: Needs examples across more than one collar family.
unification_power.demotion_trigger: Demote if only one relabeling example exists.

mechanism_specificity.evidence: Names the bridge map, preserved positivity cone, collar hypothesis, and failure mode.
mechanism_specificity.demotion_trigger: Demote if no invariant is preserved.

compression.evidence: Replaces repeated positivity checks with one preservation lemma.
compression.demotion_trigger: Demote if it covers only a single computed block.

generativity.evidence: Creates explicit collar compatibility and endpoint transfer obligations.
generativity.demotion_trigger: Demote if no new obligation follows.

transfer_reach.evidence: Transfer is substantive because source and target properties are independently specified.
transfer_reach.demotion_trigger: Demote if target property is bridge-defined.

falsifiability.evidence: A collar violating compatibility breaks the positivity-preservation conclusion.
falsifiability.demotion_trigger: Demote if no failure case survives.

boundary_sharpness.evidence: The packet explicitly does not claim continuum mass gap.
boundary_sharpness.demotion_trigger: Demote if the finite result is advertised as continuum transfer.

literature_displacement.evidence: Separates this from standard normalization by requiring same-theory positivity preservation.
literature_displacement.demotion_trigger: Demote if already present in prior transfer theorems.

transfer_substance_audit.definition_expansion_test: Pass: expanding definitions does not prove positivity preservation without the collar compatibility hypothesis.
transfer_substance_audit.independent_source_object_test: Source Wilson observable algebra is defined before normalization.
transfer_substance_audit.independent_target_property_test: Target reflection positivity cone is stated without normalization-map vocabulary.
transfer_substance_audit.nontrivial_hypothesis_test: The collar compatibility hypothesis is used to preserve the cone.
transfer_substance_audit.source_variation_test: Varying the collar outside compatibility can break preservation.
transfer_substance_audit.stress_case_test: Boundary-collar degeneracy is the stress regime.
transfer_substance_audit.failure_case_test: A collar map that reverses the reflected cone violates the conclusion.
transfer_substance_audit.consequence_delta: The finite Wilson positivity check can be transferred without redefining target positivity.
transfer_substance_audit.prior_art_delta: Differs from definitional normalization by proving preservation for independently specified source and target cones.
transfer_substance_audit.repair_certificate: Proof-quality gate must check the collar compatibility lemma.

declarative_learning_event.attempted_inference: Transfer finite reflection positivity through normalization.
declarative_learning_event.observed_result: Preservation is nontrivial and depends on the collar compatibility hypothesis.
declarative_learning_event.learned_constraint: Same-theory normalization must preserve an independently defined positivity cone.
declarative_learning_event.scope_condition: Finite same-theory Wilson block setting only.
declarative_learning_event.invalidated_generalization: Do not promote normalization if target positivity is bridge-defined.
declarative_learning_event.future_routing_effect: Route to proof-quality gate for the collar compatibility lemma.

demotion_trigger: Demote if the target positivity property is defined as the normalization image.
